preamble.summary: Isaiah 3 announces judgment on-Jerusalem-and-Judah's-leadership (vv. 1–15) and on-the-haughty-women-of-Zion (vv. 16–24, with chapter 4:1 closing the section). The catalog-of-female-finery (vv. 18–23) is the Hebrew Bible's most-detailed-list of-women's-luxury-items.
preamble.notable_variants: 3:9 'their look bears witness against them' physiognomic-judgment; 3:14–15 'you have devoured the vineyard, the plunder of the poor is in your houses' — leadership-corruption; 3:16–24 women's-luxury catalog.

variant_notes: 'For behold, the Lord GOD of hosts is taking away from Jerusalem and from Judah support and supply, all support of bread, and all support of water' tracks MT.
'The mighty man and the soldier, the judge and the prophet, the diviner and the elder' tracks MT.
'The captain of fifty and the man of rank, the counselor and the skillful magician and the expert in charms' tracks MT. LEADERSHIP-CLASSES catalog — every-pillar of society removed-in-judgment.
'And I will make boys their princes, and infants shall rule over them' tracks MT. INFANT-RULERS — Eccl 10:16 ('woe to you, O land, when your king is a child') parallels.
'And the people will oppress one another, every one his fellow and every one his neighbor; the youth will be insolent to the elder, and the despised to the honorable' tracks MT.
'For a man will take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying: You have a cloak; you shall be our leader, and this heap of ruins shall be under your rule' tracks MT.
'In that day he will speak out, saying: I will not be a healer; in my house there is neither bread nor cloak; you shall not make me leader of the people' tracks MT.
'For Jerusalem has stumbled, and Judah has fallen, because their speech and their deeds are against the LORD, defying his glorious presence' tracks MT.

'For the look on their faces bears witness against them; they proclaim their sin like Sodom; they do not hide it. Woe to them! For they have brought evil on themselves' tracks MT. PROCLAIM-SIN-LIKE-SODOM — open-shamelessness.
'Tell the righteous that it shall be well with them, for they shall eat the fruit of their deeds' tracks MT.
'Woe to the wicked! It shall be ill with him, for what his hands have dealt out shall be done to him' tracks MT.
'My people — infants are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, your guides mislead you and they have swallowed up the course of your paths' tracks MT.
'The LORD has taken his place to contend; he stands to judge peoples' tracks MT. COURTROOM-IMAGERY.

'The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders and princes of his people: It is you who have devoured the vineyard, the spoil of the poor is in your houses' tracks MT. DEVOURED-THE-VINEYARD. The vineyard-of-Israel image (Isa 5:1–7 develops). Mark 12:1–12 (parable of the wicked tenants) Christologically-extends.
'What do you mean by crushing my people, by grinding the face of the poor? declares the Lord GOD of hosts' tracks MT. GRINDING-THE-FACE-OF-THE-POOR — vivid oppression-imagery.

'The LORD said: Because the daughters of Zion are haughty and walk with outstretched necks, glancing wantonly with their eyes, mincing along as they go, tinkling with their feet' tracks MT. DAUGHTERS-OF-ZION-HAUGHTY catalog begins.
'Therefore the Lord will strike with a scab the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will lay bare their secret parts' tracks MT.

'In that day the Lord will take away the finery of the anklets, the headbands, and the crescents' tracks MT. WOMEN'S-FINERY catalog — most-detailed-list of female-luxury in the OT (vv. 18–23, ~21 items).
'The pendants, the bracelets, and the scarves' tracks MT.
'The headdresses, the armlets, the sashes, the perfume boxes, and the amulets' tracks MT.
'The signet rings and nose rings' tracks MT.
'The festal robes, the mantles, the cloaks, and the handbags' tracks MT.
'The mirrors, the linen garments, the turbans, and the veils' tracks MT.

'Instead of perfume there will be rottenness; and instead of a belt, a rope; and instead of well-set hair, baldness; and instead of a rich robe, a skirt of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty' tracks MT. INSTEAD-OF-PERFUME-ROTTENNESS — five-fold reversal-imagery.
'Your men shall fall by the sword and your mighty men in battle' tracks MT.

'And her gates shall lament and mourn; empty, she shall sit on the ground' tracks MT. SIT-ON-THE-GROUND — mourning-posture. Lamentations 1:1's 'how lonely sits the city' Christologically extends to-Jerusalem-fallen.
